text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money, because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project better. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality, because everyone follows the same standards and gives helpful feedback. Although code reviews take some time, they are worth the effort. They make the code safer, the team stronger, and the final product better for everyone.
